name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-captions
title: YouTube Captions — FlashData
description: YouTube uploader captions with timestamps for subtitle exports. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_captions access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Retrieve uploader captions for a subtitle export
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].segments. Convert start/end seconds to SRT timestamps in your application and retain text. Check languageCode and isAutoGenerated before exporting.
dev.flashdata.limits: auto=false selects existing uploader captions. This does not generate, translate or automatically substitute a missing track.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
